question: 45 people can repair a road in 10 days, working 6 hours a day. In how many days can 30 people, working 6 hours a day, complete the same work ?
solution:
Given :

M1 = 45 persons , M2 = 30 persons

D1 = 10 days , D2 = ?

H1 = 6 hours , H 2 = 6 hours 

Formula used :

M1 × D1 × H1 / work1 = M2 × D2 × H 2 / work2

Calculations : 

On Substituting the values in the formula, we get:

45 x 6 x 10 = 30 × 6 × days

⇒ 2700 = 180 × days 

⇒ days = 2700 / 180 = 15 days

 ∴ 30 persons will complete the work in 15 days.
